title: Personalised news is currently broken because it prioritises speed over substance.
body:
Most news feeds today are designed to keep you scrolling by serving up whatever is loudest or most controversial. That is not personalisation. That is just an algorithm chasing engagement at the expense of your time and your peace of mind.

At Headlinne, we are building something different. The next step for personalised news is not about serving you more content. It is about serving you the right content based on your actual interests and your need for clarity. We are moving toward a model where the AI acts as a sophisticated editor rather than a content aggregator.

This means building tools that respect your intelligence. We are focusing on systems that can filter out noise and summarise complex topics without stripping away the nuance. The goal is to give you a complete picture of the day in minutes, not hours.

Technology should help us understand the world better, not just consume more of it. We are committed to making sure that remains the core of our roadmap.
cta: You can see where we are heading at HEADLINNE.com.
